notes.title: Update notes for 03 Jan
notes.content:
Hi there!

We hope everybody had a good start into 2025. 

We have recently published an update for the game as a reaction to the feedback in curator and user reviews. We take this feedback very seriously, which is why we focused mostly on functionality in this update for now. In a next step we will focus heavily on improving and adding more gameplay content.

Here is a list of changes in the first technical update:

[list]
[*] Free movement within levels! This is a requirement for what we planned in our upcoming content update
[*] A tutorial has been added to the game.
[*] We changed our sound engine so that 3D sounds can be interpreted better by the player
[*] Several adjustable features for the controls have been added. Adjustments can be made in the settings
[*] General bugfixes
[*] We added a first intro scene. More scenes and cutscenes are planned and will be coming soon
[*] Grabbing animations have been improved
[*] Physics of objects have been improved
[*] There is now a radial selection menu for better support of specific controllers.
[*] Slight graphical adjustments
[/list]

That's it for now! We will give more insight into additional content within the next days.

We wish you a lot of fun trying out the new features

notes.title: Release
notes.content:
Dear Players,

The first version of Infernum VR was released this weekend, and we are already hard at work on the second level. We will continuously keep you updated here on the development process of the game and stay in touch with you regarding feedback, suggestions, and more, as promised.

Good luck in Satan's lair!
